build.reason: The supplied recipe builds a static json-c archive and links this C++ target to it; CMake includes json_tokener.c in that library.

input.reason: The entry forwards fuzzer bytes and their length to parse_ex; ordinary finite number inputs are accepted by this route.

lifecycle.reason: Under normal allocation, the target creates one tokener, releases the returned object, and frees the tokener; json_object_put accepts a null parse result.

control_flow.reason: The fixed entry makes only one parse_ex call on a fresh default tokener, preventing incremental-state reconstruction and strict-mode parsing.

accepted.requirement: Exercise parse_ex number continuation across calls on one tokener, including reconstruction of a saved exponent and rejection of a misplaced following minus sign.
accepted.target_route: Create a tokener; call parse_ex with an initial partial number, then call parse_ex again on that same tokener with the continuation.
accepted.failure_condition: The entry makes exactly one parse_ex call, then frees the tokener. A finite witness is chunks "[0e+" and "-]": the second call reaches saved exponent reconstruction and the invalid-minus guard.
accepted.alternative_paths: A single complete input can exercise ordinary exponent or minus parsing, but cannot supply saved state from an earlier call; no other call sequence exists in the complete entry.

accepted.requirement: Reach the supported strict-mode response to an incomplete exponent in parse_ex.
accepted.target_route: Set JSON_TOKENER_STRICT on the tokener, then parse a finite input such as "[0e]".
accepted.failure_condition: The target never sets flags; its default tokener remains non-strict, so the incomplete exponent is trimmed and accepted instead of taking the strict rejection route.
accepted.alternative_paths: Changing only input bytes cannot enable JSON_TOKENER_STRICT. The complete entry has no flag-setting or equivalent strict parse route.

source_evidence.quote:
/* The behavior when missing the exponent varies slightly */
    {"0e", 2, 2, json_tokener_continue, 1},
    {"0e", 3, 2, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"0e", 3, 2, json_tokener_error_parse_eof, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
    {"[0e]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"[0e]", -1, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},

    {"0e+", 3, 3, json_tokener_continue, 1},
    {"0e+", 4, 3, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"0e+", 4, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_eof, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
    {"[0e+]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"[0e+]", -1, 4, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
